from pathlib import Path
import ast
p=Path('candidate.py')
s=p.read_text()
header='''\"\"\"Prospective r0021: separate shared-row ties from remaining timestamp ties.

Inherited r0019-latest_activity source SHA256:
3c25fe6b091cf0da3995d8fa5e87c4847a327bfc6e931cdb40c711e29e35d223.
Only the last eight deterministic classifier inputs change. A 2x2 retains
or removes shared-row and no-shared-row tie indicators. Keeping both exactly
reproduces r0020-ordinal_folded inputs. Neither means support-only.
A shared row is an observed supplied history row, not an inferred item ID.
No training, scoring, source-system reproduction or verified novelty claim.
\"\"\"'''
start=s.index('import math')
s=header+'\\n'+s[start:]
t=ast.parse(s)
config_node=next(n for n in t.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(x,ast.Name) and x.id=='CONFIG' for x in n.targets))
config=ast.literal_eval(config_node.value)
config.update(tie_joint='keep',tie_residual='drop')
lines=s.splitlines(keepends=True)
lines[config_node.lineno-1:config_node.end_lineno]=['CONFIG = '+repr(config)+'\\n']
s=''.join(lines)
needle='    def _statistics(self, batch):'
insert='''        # Deterministic selectors only: all parent parameters and RNG fixed.
        if self.frontier_reduction "'!= '"'latest' or self.frontier_population "'!= '"'activity':
            raise ValueError('The r0019 latest/activity parent is frozen')
        self.tie_joint = self.config['tie_joint']
        self.tie_residual = self.config['tie_residual']
        if self.tie_joint not in ('keep', 'drop') or self.tie_residual not in ('keep', 'drop'):
            raise ValueError('Unknown tie decomposition selector')

'''
s=s.replace(needle,insert+needle,1)
s=s[:s.index('    def forward(self, batch):')]
s+='''    def _tie_statistics(self, batch, order, scopes, frontier):
        \"\"\"Disjoint binary tables [B,2,4] on the exact inherited gate.

        T: latest receiving activity age equals the crossed match anchor age.
        J: T and at least one SINGLE supplied row belongs to both populations
           at that age (receiving valid action/field plus other-field match).
        D = T-J: ties with no such shared-row witness. D does not assert that
           hidden item identities differ; there is no item ID in the input.
        Same-action anchors are preferred, else pooled-action anchors. A
        pooled fallback cannot have J: that would imply a same-action match.
        All modes compute all tables, without changing any parent tensors.
        Padding and unknown types/IDs never form witnesses; finite sentinels
        support zero-length histories, missing fields and arbitrary ordering.
        \"\"\"
        mask = batch['history_mask']
        types = batch['history_type']
        ids = torch.arange(1, 5, device=types.device)
        action_mask = (types.unsqueeze(-1) == ids) & mask.unsqueeze(-1)
        known_action = action_mask.any(dim=-1)
        ages = batch['history_age_seconds'].float().masked_fill(~mask, 0.0)
        expanded = ages.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, 4)
        sentinel = ages.new_full((ages.shape[0], 1, 4), torch.finfo(ages.dtype).max)
        pooled_sentinel = ages.new_full((ages.shape[0], 1), torch.finfo(ages.dtype).max)
        gate = frontier['gate']
        ties, joints = [], []
        for field, (column, index) in enumerate((('history_category', self.category),
                                                ('history_brand', self.brand))):
            history = batch[column]
            target = batch['static'][:, index:index + 1]
            valid = mask & (history > 0) & (target > 0)
            activity = action_mask & valid.unsqueeze(-1)
            minimum = torch.cat([
                expanded.masked_fill(~activity, torch.finfo(ages.dtype).max), sentinel
            ], dim=1).amin(dim=1)
            latest = torch.where(activity.any(dim=1), minimum, torch.zeros_like(minimum))
            other_column = 'history_brand' if field == 0 else 'history_category'
            other_index = self.brand if field == 0 else self.category
            other_history = batch[other_column]
            other_target = batch['static'][:, other_index:other_index + 1]
            matches = (mask & known_action & (other_history > 0) &
                       (other_target > 0) & (other_history == other_target))
            pooled_minimum = torch.cat([
                ages.masked_fill(~matches, torch.finfo(ages.dtype).max), pooled_sentinel
            ], dim=1).amin(dim=1)
            pooled = torch.where(matches.any(dim=1), pooled_minimum,
                                 torch.zeros_like(pooled_minimum))
            anchor = torch.where(scopes['same_presence'][:, field, :].bool(),
                                 order['anchors'][:, 1 - field, :], pooled[:, None])
            tie = (latest == anchor).float() * gate[:, field, :]
            witness = (activity & matches.unsqueeze(-1) &
                       (expanded == anchor.unsqueeze(1))).any(dim=1)
            joint = witness.float() * tie
            ties.append(tie)
            joints.append(joint)
        tie, joint = torch.stack(ties, dim=1), torch.stack(joints, dim=1)
        residual = tie - joint
        ordinal = frontier['latest_activity']
        # Exact historical folded tensor; dyadic arithmetic is exact here.
        folded = torch.maximum(ordinal, gate - ordinal)
        return {
            'gate': gate, 'tie': tie, 'joint': joint, 'residual': residual,
            'keep_keep': folded,
            'keep_drop': gate - 0.5 * joint,
            'drop_keep': gate - 0.5 * residual,
            'drop_drop': gate,
        }

    def _tie_inputs(self, scopes, ties, joint=None, residual=None):
        joint = self.tie_joint if joint is None else joint
        residual = self.tie_residual if residual is None else residual
        if joint not in ('keep', 'drop') or residual not in ('keep', 'drop'):
            raise ValueError('Unknown diagnostic tie selector')
        return torch.cat([
            scopes['same_rank'].flatten(start_dim=1),
            (0.5 * ties[joint + '_' + residual]).flatten(start_dim=1),
        ], dim=-1)

    def forward(self, batch):
        parent, _ = self._parent_features(batch)
        order = self._order_statistics(batch)
        scopes = self._anchor_scope_statistics(batch, order)
        tables = self._routing_tables(scopes)
        frontier = self._frontier_statistics(batch, order, scopes, tables)
        ties = self._tie_statistics(batch, order, scopes, frontier)
        return self.output(torch.cat([
            parent, self._tie_inputs(scopes, ties)
        ], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)

    def diagnostics(self, batch):
        \"\"\"Candidate first512 probes, no labels; not population attribution.

        Denominators clamp at one for empty supports. Replacement distances
        use a fixed checkpoint and do not replace retrained factorial cells.
        \"\"\"
        parent, views = self._parent_features(batch)
        order = self._order_statistics(batch)
        scopes = self._anchor_scope_statistics(batch, order)
        tables = self._routing_tables(scopes)
        frontier = self._frontier_statistics(batch, order, scopes, tables)
        ties = self._tie_statistics(batch, order, scopes, frontier)
        inputs = self._tie_inputs(scopes, ties)
        logits = self.output(torch.cat([parent, inputs], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)
        other_joint = 'drop' if self.tie_joint == 'keep' else 'keep'
        other_residual = 'drop' if self.tie_residual == 'keep' else 'keep'
        flipped_joint = self.output(torch.cat([
            parent, self._tie_inputs(scopes, ties, joint=other_joint)
        ], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)
        flipped_residual = self.output(torch.cat([
            parent, self._tie_inputs(scopes, ties, residual=other_residual)
        ], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)
        parent_inputs = self._frontier_inputs(scopes, frontier)
        parent_logits = self.output(torch.cat([parent, parent_inputs], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)
        gate, tie, joint, residual = (ties[k] for k in ('gate', 'tie', 'joint', 'residual'))
        selected = ties[self.tie_joint + '_' + self.tie_residual]
        ordinal = frontier['latest_activity']
        empty = (~batch['history_mask'].any(dim=1)).float()
        missing = ((batch['static'][:, self.category] == 0) |
                   (batch['static'][:, self.brand] == 0)).float()
        denom = gate.sum().clamp_min(1.0)
        result = {
            'diagnostic_sample_count': selected.new_tensor(selected.shape[0]),
            'empty_history_count': empty.sum(),
            'missing_target_count': missing.sum(),
            'same_support_fraction': scopes['same_presence'].mean(),
            'selected_support_fraction': gate.mean(),
            'fallback_support_fraction': (gate - scopes['same_presence']).mean(),
            'support_subset_violation_max': (scopes['same_presence'] - gate).clamp_min(0.0).max(),
            'tie_fraction_given_support': tie.sum() / denom,
            'joint_fraction_given_support': joint.sum() / denom,
            'residual_fraction_given_support': residual.sum() / denom,
            'joint_fraction_given_tie': joint.sum() / tie.sum().clamp_min(1.0),
            'tie_ordinal_identity_error_max': (tie - 2.0 * torch.minimum(ordinal, gate - ordinal)).abs().max(),
            'partition_identity_error_max': (tie - joint - residual).abs().max(),
            'partition_overlap_error_max': (joint * residual).abs().max(),
            'joint_subset_tie_violation_max': (joint - tie).clamp_min(0.0).max(),
            'joint_fallback_abs_max': (joint * (gate - scopes['same_presence'])).abs().max(),
            'residual_lower_bound_violation_max': (-residual).clamp_min(0.0).max(),
            'folded_identity_error_max': (ties['keep_keep'] - (gate - 0.5 * tie)).abs().max(),
            'factorial_additivity_error_max': (ties['keep_keep'] - ties['keep_drop'] - ties['drop_keep'] + ties['drop_drop']).abs().max(),
            'main_rank_identity_error_max': (inputs[:, :8] - parent_inputs[:, :8]).abs().max(),
            'selected_bounds_violation_max': torch.maximum((-selected).clamp_min(0.0).max(), (selected - 1.0).clamp_min(0.0).max()),
            'outside_support_abs_max': (selected.abs() * (1.0 - gate)).max(),
            'empty_inputs_abs_max': (inputs.abs() * empty[:, None]).max(),
            'missing_inputs_abs_max': (inputs.abs() * missing[:, None]).max(),
            'selected_aux_abs_mean': (0.5 * selected).abs().mean(),
            'joint_replacement_logit_distance_mean': (logits - flipped_joint).abs().mean(),
            'residual_replacement_logit_distance_mean': (logits - flipped_residual).abs().mean(),
            'parent_replacement_logit_distance_mean': (logits - parent_logits).abs().mean(),
            'aux_input_weight_norm': self.output[0].weight[:, -8:].norm(),
            'parent_weight_sum_error_max': (views['shared_weights'].sum(-1) - (1.0 - empty)).abs().max(),
            'empty_parent_pool_norm_max': (views['selected'].norm(dim=-1) * empty).max(),
        }
        for f, field in enumerate(('category', 'brand')):
            for a, action in enumerate(('pv', 'cart', 'fav', 'buy')):
                prefix = field + '_' + action + '_'
                local = gate[:, f, a].sum().clamp_min(1.0)
                result[prefix + 'support_fraction'] = gate[:, f, a].mean()
                result[prefix + 'joint_given_support'] = joint[:, f, a].sum() / local
                result[prefix + 'residual_given_support'] = residual[:, f, a].sum() / local
        return result
'''
p.write_text(s)
for name,joint,residual in [('ties_both','keep','keep'),('ties_residual','drop','keep'),('ties_neither','drop','drop')]:
    c={**config,'tie_joint':joint,'tie_residual':residual}
    Path(name+'.py').write_text(s.replace('CONFIG = '+repr(config),'CONFIG = '+repr(c),1))
print('Wrote four standalone model modules; no model code executed.')
PY"

        pooled fallback cannot have J: that would imply a same-action match.
        All modes compute all tables, without changing any parent tensors.

def validate(value,schema,path):
    typ=schema.get('type')
    if typ=='object':
        assert isinstance(value,dict),path
        assert set(schema.get('required',[]))<=set(value),(path,'missing')
        if schema.get('additionalProperties') is False:
            assert set(value)<=set(schema.get('properties',{})),(path,'extra')
        for k,v in value.items():
            if k in schema.get('properties',{}):validate(v,schema['properties'][k],path+'.'+k)
    elif typ=='array':
        assert isinstance(value,list),path
        assert len(value)>=schema.get('minItems',0),path
        for i,v in enumerate(value):validate(v,schema.get('items',{}),path+'['+str(i)+']')
    elif typ=='string':assert isinstance(value,str) and len(value)>=schema.get('minLength',0),path
    elif typ=='boolean':assert isinstance(value,bool),path
    elif typ is not None:raise AssertionError(('unhandled schema',typ,path))
    if 'enum' in schema:assert value in schema['enum'],path
    if 'const' in schema:assert value==schema['const'],path
